text:
sara-infra: follow-up from the postmortem: cross-region TLS retry spike tied to DNS rotation and a route-preference bug. need owners and timelines for short/medium/long fixes.

mike-sre: taking LB rollback + emergency runbook. will draft steps and canary plan. ETA 72h.

tanvi-net: i'll investigate registrar throttling and TTL jitter; plan to add a staged zone-rollout runbook. ETA 7d.

jordan-eng: will own client retry/backoff tuning with feature-flag and metrics. PR and canary in 4d.

deploy-bot: deploy 4126 to prod (canary eu-west-1) completed, no deploy errors.

mike-sre: WIP haproxy rollback snippet and smoke-tests will go into the playbook.

tanvi-net: proposing alert suppression during zone publishes + regional TLS synthetic probes. example expr: increase(edge_tls_handshake_failures[10m]) / increase(edge_tls_handshake_attempts[10m]) > 0.015 for 10m.

jordan-eng: sandbox tests show retries drop from ~3.5% -> 0.6% with new backoff. gating: 5% -> 25%.

sara-infra: action items (owner  due):
- LB rollback playbook + canary  mike-sre  72h
- Registrar throttle RCA + runbook  tanvi-net  7d
- Retry/backoff PR + canary  jordan-eng  4d
- Regional TLS canaries + alert tuning  tanvi-net  5d
- Postmortem updates + graphs  sara-infra  48h

mike-sre: i'll schedule an ops window and coordinate on-call.

tanvi-net: attaching registrar logs to runbook PR; registrar notes 429 bursts for >30 updates, will stagger.

jordan-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/retries/pull/451 - feature-flag, backoff, telemetry.

sara-infra: set 10am PT check-in next Tue. ops-bot created weekly follow-up.

ops-bot: Reminder: incident follow-up on 2026-03-31 10:00 PT.

sara-infra: closing thread; will reopen if any blocker on the 72h LB deliverable.
